hypothesis: Instruction count varies mainly with prefix lookup length, sequence block count, cache state, and priority-queue removal cost.

pcvs.name: prefix_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Bounds the number of full blocks examined during prefix-cache lookup.

pcvs.name: sequence_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Tracks block allocation and block-table processing work.

pcvs.name: waiting_queue_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures variation in priority-queue removal work.

pcvs.name: cached_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Provides cheap cache-state information distinguishing cold and populated prefix caches.
